# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 2: Brains and Neural Networks**

A real look at how brain cells work, and how computer scientists copied the idea to build AI.

We will act out a neural network as a class, watch one learn on screen, and train our own. Then we will see how the same idea works inside AI that sees pictures and AI that writes.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Explain how a brain cell (neuron) sends a signal
* Explain how practice changes the brain
* Explain how an artificial neuron copies that idea
* Train a neural network and watch it learn
* Explain how AI sees pictures and how a chatbot picks its next word

***

## Topics in This Unit

[**Simple Rules, Complex Behavior**](2.1_Simple_Rules_Complex_Behavior.qmd)\
Make a human wave and a human Rule 30. See how tiny rules make chaos, and watch the Game of Life.

[**Your Brain Is Made of Cells**](2.2_Your_Brain_Is_Made_of_Cells.qmd)\
Catch a falling ruler, pass a squeeze around the room, and learn how a neuron sends a signal.

[**How Brains Learn**](2.3_How_Brains_Learn.qmd)\
Write with your other hand, meet Pavlov's dogs, and graph your own learning with mirror drawing.

[**The Artificial Neuron**](2.4_The_Artificial_Neuron.qmd)\
Multiply, add, compare. The class acts out a neuron that adds up signals and decides to fire.

[**Train a Human Neural Network**](2.5_Train_a_Human_Neural_Network.qmd)\
The class becomes a neuron that starts with the wrong idea, then fixes its weights after every mistake.

[**Watch Mr. Ross Build an AI**](2.6_Watch_Mr_Ross_Build_an_AI.qmd)\
Six steps to build an AI. Predict, then watch a real neural network learn from 1,281 Pokémon.

[**Train Your Own AI**](2.7_Train_Your_Own_AI.qmd)\
Teach Teachable Machine your own hand signs. Then try to fool it.

[**How AI Sees**](2.8_How_AI_Sees.qmd)\
A picture is a grid of numbers. Color by number, then find the edges with a filter.

[**How Chatbots Work**](2.9_How_Chatbots_Work.qmd)\
Build a tiny chatbot that only counts which word comes next. Roll dice to make it write.
